nameOrigin: Japanese scientific name of the ‘dwarf flying squirrel’

pokedexEntries.bk: The energy made in its cheeks’ electric pouches is stored inside its membrane and released while it is gliding.

pokedexEntries.wh: They live on treetops and glide using the inside of a cape-like membrane while discharging electricity.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: It glides on its outstretched membrane while shocking foes with the electricity stored in the pouches on its cheeks.

pokedexEntries.x: They live on treetops and glide using the inside of a cape-like membrane while discharging electricity.

pokedexEntries.or: They live on treetops and glide using the inside of a cape-like membrane while discharging electricity.

pokedexEntries.y: The energy made in its cheeks’ electric pouches is stored inside its membrane and released while it is gliding.

pokedexEntries.as: The energy made in its cheeks’ electric pouches is stored inside its membrane and released while it is gliding.

pokedexEntries.su: It glides using its cape-like membrane. Electrical energy scatters from it, shocking its friends and foes alike.

pokedexEntries.mo: It grills berries and bug Pokémon with electric shocks and makes a meal of them. It usually nests in the holes gouged in trees by Pikipek.

pokedexEntries.us: They store up electricity to fly through the air. When thunder cracks at night, sometimes there are almost enough of them to blot out the sky.

pokedexEntries.um: As it flies, it scatters electricity around, so bird Pokémon keep their distance. That’s why Emolga can keep all its food to itself.

pokedexEntries.sw: As Emolga flutters through the air, it crackles with electricity. This Pokémon is cute, but it can cause a lot of trouble.

pokedexEntries.sh: This Pokémon absolutely loves sweet berries. Sometimes it stuffs its cheeks full of so much food that it can’t fly properly.
